fields.cover_headline: 4 distribution habits that deserve a {r:red card}
fields.cover_sub: For every founder growing an app.
fields.step1_body:
Each habit waits for buyers to find you.
Buyers don't search for apps they don't know.
They ask for help in public instead.
Here's the first card.
fields.step2_body:
Launch day gets likes. Then the feed moves on.
Post something useful every day after.
Turn each user question into a post.
The next card gets you banned.
fields.step3_body:
A link with no answer reads like an ad.
Answer the question in full first.
Link only if they ask.
But first, find the right threads.
fields.step4_body:
Nobody searches for an app they don't know.
They describe the problem instead.
Search for the problem, not your name.
I broke the last card myself.
fields.step5_body:
My first 2 paying users found me.
I still don't know how.
Ask every new user where they found you.
Then do more of that.
fields.cta_subtext: Send this to a founder holding one of these cards. Follow for one distribution move a day.
